steps: With your main job at level 10 or higher, enter Windurst Walls on foot from Windurst Waters or Windurst Woods.

title: Burgeoning Dread
requirements: Travel on foot for the exit scene.
steps: Leave Windurst Woods for East Sarutabaruta on foot. Alternatively, leave Windurst Waters or Port Windurst for West Sarutabaruta.
Watch the scene and record which Enfeeblement Kit was requested: Poison, Blind, Sleep or Silence. Your assignment determines the potion needed for the next synthesis.

title: That Which Curdles Blood
requirements: Alchemy around 10 recommended; the final synthesis caps at 8.
Final kit is Exclusive and must be synthesized by your own character.
steps: Read your assigned kit type. Recipe information is available from Kuroido-Moido (Port Windurst E-7), Faulpie (Southern San d'Oria E-8) or Abd-al-Raziq (Bastok Mines L-7).
Prepare one Padded Box, two Fine Parchments and two Enchanted Inks. You may obtain the components from other players or synthesize them yourself.

Padded Box recipe: Earth Crystal + two Bast Parchments + one Inferior Cocoon. Fine Parchment recipe, twice: Dark Crystal + Parchment + Pumice Stone. Enchanted Ink recipe, twice: Dark Crystal + Black Ink + Magicked Blood.
Synthesize the requested kit yourself: Earth Crystal + Padded Box + two Fine Parchments + two Enchanted Inks + the assigned Poison, Blind, Sleep or Silence Potion.
Trade the completed matching kit to the Trodden Snow at Qufim H-7 for the scene and six Domina seals.
reward: Moogle key and six Domina seals.

title: Sugar-coated Directive
requirements: Access to at least three cloisters and a party prepared for Prime-avatar battles.
steps: Choose at least three elemental cloisters. Routes: Frost through Fei'Yin; Flames through Ifrit's Cauldron; Gales through Cape Teriggan; Storms through The Boyahda Tree; Tides through Den of Rancor; Tremors through Quicksand Caves.
At each destination, examine the Protocrystal and choose Sugar-coated Directive. Defeat that element's Prime avatar.
After winning, examine the Protocrystal again to apply the Domina seal and obtain its counterseal. A battlefield win without this second interaction does not finish that destination.
Return to Qufim H-7 and examine the Trodden Snow with at least three counterseals. Three completes the mission; four, five or six increase the gil reward. Decide before handing them in.

title: Enemy of the Empire (I)
requirements: Ability to reach the assigned Sea Serpent Grotto targets.
steps: Speak to Andrause at I-8 and record the three monster names he assigns. These targets vary between characters.
Obtain a Soultrapper camera and Blank Soul Plates, equip them in the appropriate ranged/ammunition slots and travel into Sea Serpent Grotto.
Use the Soultrapper on living monsters with the requested names to create Soul Plates. Take additional photographs if necessary; ordinary monster drops are not the requested evidence.
Return to Andrause and trade the three matching Soul Plates individually. After he accepts the full set, finish his dialogue and receive the Black book.
notes: Confirm the item names if using Andrause's supply menu: the reviewed source has an inconsistent item constant in its plate-purchase branch.

title: Enemy of the Empire (II)
steps: Reach the Outcropping at F-10 in Gustav Tunnel and examine it for the scene, then prepare for the confrontation.
Fight the agents Bompupu, Gorattz and Renfred. Their initial copies lead into the real agents and further clones.
Identify the real agents by their greater durability and ninjutsu casting. Defeating a real agent removes that agent's copies; keep healing and crowd control ready as the groups overlap.
After victory, examine the Outcropping again for the required concluding scene before leaving.

title: Shantotto in Chains
requirements: Slashing, blunt, piercing melee, ranged and suitable elemental magic damage.
Nighttime access for the Zi'Tah NMs.
steps: Find the Ensorcelled Door at B-10. Gather all six luminous fragment key items from the following NMs; bring the required damage types.

In Ro'Maeve: Lode Golem at E-9/E-10 takes Blizzard, Water or Stone magic (blue fragment); Fired Urn at K-9/K-10 takes slashing damage (purple); Steely Weapon at G-10/G-11 takes ranged attacks (yellow).

In The Sanctuary of Zi'Tah, search at night, 17:00–07:00: Holey Horror at H-8 takes piercing melee damage (green); Skeleton Scuffler at F-8 takes blunt damage (red); Blest Bones near F-7 takes Thunder, Fire or Wind magic (beige).
Check your key items after each victory. Once you hold all six, return to the Ensorcelled Door and examine it for the story scene.

title: Battaru Royale
requirements: At least one elemental sap; all eight recommended for level-75 attempts.
steps: After the introductory scene, examine the Moon Spiral again while holding at least one elemental sap and choose Battaru Royale.
Defeat the eight elemental Tarutaru clones. Control the group and fight them individually where possible, keeping a recovery area clear.

At roughly half health, each clone calls its matching avatar for an Astral Flow attack. The corresponding sap collected beforehand reduces that danger; keep the party healed before pushing each clone through this point.
Finish all eight and watch the victory sequence. Return to Aldo in Lower Jeuno for the next mission.

title: Sisters in Arms
requirements: Paintbrush of Souls on one party member for the normal Temple of Uggalepih → Den of Rancor route.
Unlit Lanterns for the four-flame chamber gate.
steps: Gather the sixteen Tablet of Hexes key items on the route to Sacrificial Chamber. The complete set supplies the intended level-75 battle enhancements.
Temple map 1: Malice F-10, Deceit F-8. Temple map 2: Envy F-8, Greed G-10, Pride J-11, Bale I-8.
Den of Rancor map 1: Strife H-6, Regret E-5, Dolor J-9, Agony E-10, Rancor F-11, Rage K-11, Despair J-13.
Den map 3: Penury F-9. Den map 2: Death L-13 and Blight H-9. Check that all sixteen are in key items before entering the battle.

For the normal Sacrificial Chamber route, light all four access lanterns using Rancor Flames from the Den's D-5/E-5 Altar of Rancor. An Unlit Lantern can be reused by returning to the altar after each lighting.
Enter Sacrificial Chamber and examine the Mahogany Door for the scene that starts Project: Shantottofication.
notes: The references differ on whether a tablet is compulsory for credit. Collecting all sixteen avoids that ambiguity and supplies the battle bonuses.
reward: Tablet enhancements and access to the final story battlefield.

title: Project: Shantottofication
requirements: All sixteen tablets strongly recommended for level-75 attempts.
steps: After the opening scene, examine the Mahogany Door again and choose Project: Shantottofication. The collected tablets are consumed on entry and supply their battle enhancements.

Fight D. Shantotto and Shantotto with a plan to manage both targets. D. Shantotto uses scythe attacks and poison/paralysis; Shantotto uses staff attacks with stun, slow, silence and plague. Bring appropriate status-removal supplies.
Near half health, either can trigger a rage phase that brings them together for skillchains. The raging target cannot be finished during that phase, even at 1% HP; prioritize survival until it ends.
Defeat both, finish the scene and then return to Windurst Walls for the epilogue.
notes: The full tablet set raises attributes/resistances and triples HP/MP, with a special Reraise effect. It is not a permanent character bonus.
